label: How many days were you so unwell that you stayed in bed or on the sofa due to Coronavirus? - Covid wave 3 (age 75 years)
meta_rows: How many days were you so unwell that you stayed in bed or on the sofa due to Coronavirus? - Covid wave 3 (age 75 years)
Questions about health - Covid wave 3 questionnaire. This was not asked in wave 1 or 2.
cat_rows: This category contains data about the general and physical health which also includes experiences of covid symptoms, testing for Coronavirus and suffering from common health illnesses asked in the 2020-2021 covid questionnaires where the participant was 74 years. Healthcare questions were also included in this category.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
